notes: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\<MaigretLauncher|PhoneLookup|TorBotLauncher|ScannerLauncher>\<maigret|phone|torbot|scanner>-gate.json to customize. mode is "vpn" (default) or "routed-proxy"; the two are exclusive. In vpn mode a VPN counts only when the adapter is Up AND the routing table sends public traffic through it; patterns are case-insensitive wildcard matches against '<adapter name> <adapter description>' and need at least 3 characters. routedProxy sample (set mode to "routed-proxy"; vpnNamePatterns is then not used): "routedProxy": { "url": "http://203.0.113.10:3128", "verifyHost": "example.com", "allowPrivate": false, "tlsToProxy": false, "connectTimeoutSeconds": 5 }. Only http proxies are supported (https only with tlsToProxy=true; SOCKS is rejected because squid cannot chain SOCKS parents); loopback, link-local, multicast, unspecified and this host's own addresses are always rejected, and private/CGNAT/ULA addresses need allowPrivate=true. Ambient HTTP(S)_PROXY variables are never read. proxyUrls is retired: keep it empty or remove it (a non-empty value is rejected as a config error). Tailscale is mesh networking, not a privacy VPN.
